query_analysis.original_query: I need to develop a comprehensive predictive model for solids discharge in our nozzle discharge solid-bowl centrifuge. What factors should we prioritize to minimize operational instabilities?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a detailed and accurate predictive model for solids discharge behavior in a nozzle discharge solid-bowl centrifuge, identifying and prioritizing critical factors to minimize operational instabilities and enhance performance.

selected_agents.role: Lead development of the predictive model and identification of critical operational factors
Analyze operational instabilities and advise on stability enhancement
Develop and validate mathematical aspects of the predictive model

communication_strategy.information_flow: Integration of process knowledge with dynamics analysis and mathematical modeling
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative development with continuous feedback among agents to refine model accuracy and operational recommendations

clarification_questions: What are the specific operational parameters and conditions of your centrifuge?
Do you have existing data on solids discharge and operational instabilities?
What are the properties of the solids being processed?
Are there any constraints on modifying operational parameters or equipment design?
